スポーツ市場は伸びているのに、関心層は減っている――2026年秋の六つのニュースを読み解く

Six stories from autumn 2026, read through a Japanese-first English Mix lens. Stadium spending grows while broader sports participation spending falls; fan loyalty differs from recommendation; exercise intentions face friction; MLB tests outfield positioning; the Cubs explore custom bats; and a regional baseball seminar asks what data can actually change. Facts, interpretation and uncertainty remain separate.
